# Claim-level evidence ledger

One row per important claim/signal. Keep source IDs stable within this run.

| Evidence ID | Candidate/signal | Claim supported or contradicted | Evidence class | Source ID(s) | Provider / retrieval | Quote/paraphrase (brief) | Geography/population | Industry/category | Publish date | Event/observation date | Access date | Source tier/type | Independence cluster | Corroborated by (independent) | Confidence | Limitations | Falsification note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

"Corroborated by" lists source IDs from a *different* independence cluster that support the same claim, or "none found". A FACT claim must cite a page that was actually opened. A search snippet alone is not enough when the page can reasonably be inspected.

## Source independence notes

Group sources that repeat the same release, survey, original dataset or company claim. Do not count each derivative article as an independent signal.
